scenario.name: r-rc-1-threshold-reject
scenario.description: request_compaction structured context-guard reject via disposable session (below threshold, or usage not measured yet)

expectedReceipts.name: tool-registered
expectedReceipts.description: Direct tools.effective inventory contains request_compaction for the disposable session

expectedReceipts.name: tool-invoked
expectedReceipts.description: The current row nonce appears in a typed request_compaction invocation with a correlation ID

expectedReceipts.name: tool-invoke-rejected
expectedReceipts.description: Authoritative request_compaction toolResult is bound by toolCallId to this row's nonce-bearing invocation and returned status=rejected with guard=context_threshold (measured below the floor) or guard=context_unmeasured (usage not measured yet)

expectedReceipts.name: tempo-trace-json
expectedReceipts.description: Public-safe Tempo trace JSON (tempo-trace-<id>.json) holding the row’s request_compaction tool-execution span, collected by collect-continuation-trace.mjs. Required for every continuation row (#600).

expectedReceipts.name: tool-trace-correlation
expectedReceipts.description: tool-trace-correlation.json: exactly one Tempo trace on this seat inside the row’s evidence window, holding one request_compaction tool-execution span.

review.notes: Threshold Reject. Validates direct typed-tool registration, this row's nonce-bearing invocation, and the matching structured toolResult rejection. Safe to run: mutates=false. Assistant sentinel prose cannot satisfy this synchronous reject row, and the Tempo trace is never its verdict authority. Since #600 the trace is review-completeness debt: tempo-trace-json and tool-trace-correlation are required receipts, so a missing trace keeps the row review-pending without changing its verdict.

census.limits: request_compaction is tool-only and has no token form. The census found no span records whether a request was accepted or refused, so the accept/refuse distinction that is this row’s whole claim exists only in the structured toolResult. The trace receipt can show only that one request_compaction tool span ran on this seat in the row’s window; it records review completeness, never the verdict.

spans.name: openclaw.tool.execution
spans.notes: Typed request_compaction executions are visible but carry no accepted/rejected outcome.

attributes.notes: Accepted entry spans carry no signal.kind on the census product basis; origin is contracted by R-OBS-CONT-PROVENANCE.
No k6/Project-81 resource or trace marker exists, so this row’s traffic cannot be separated from organic fleet traffic in a later census.

redaction.rule: The trace is published as a public-safe Tempo projection of the tool-execution span. Prompt bodies, raw nonces, raw session keys, and gateway tokens never enter the artifact.

controls.positive: tools.effective lists request_compaction, this row’s nonce-bearing typed invocation is observed, and its toolResult returns status=rejected with guard=context_threshold or guard=context_unmeasured.
controls.negative: Assistant prose cannot pass the row, and a trace alone can neither satisfy nor block its verdict.

backendUnavailable.notes: A degraded or empty Tempo answer leaves tempo-trace-json and its correlation receipt pending. That is review debt, not evidence that the continuation did not happen, and it never changes the VU verdict.

verdictAuthority.pass: The nonce-bound request_compaction toolResult returns a structured rejection with no compaction side effect: either guard=context_threshold (measured below the floor) or guard=context_unmeasured with a live cause (no_fresh_usage | unknown_context_window). An unmeasured rejection never counts as measured below-threshold proof. guard=context_threshold with inventory-only wording, or any inventory_only cause on the live seat, is non-PASS. Behavioral only; the trace receipts decide review completeness, not the verdict.
verdictAuthority.partial: Registration, invocation, or the structured rejection is missing. A missing trace keeps the row review-pending without changing its class.
verdictAuthority.fail: Not emitted by this scenario: an incomplete run is PARTIAL-candidate. Neither trace receipt can produce or clear a FAIL.

execution.deterministicK6: r-rc-1-threshold-reject.js invokes request_compaction in a disposable session and reads the toolResult.
execution.manual: Manual Tempo review can confirm the tool span; it carries no outcome.
execution.relationship: The deterministic row owns the verdict. The Tempo trace receipts decide only whether review is complete; manual review corroborates topology and never upgrades a missing receipt.

liveRunSafety.notes: Live request_compaction reject row. Prefer OPENCLAW_CREATE_DISPOSABLE_SESSION=true. Requires direct tools.effective registration, this row's nonce-bearing typed invocation, and the matching authoritative role=toolResult rejection: guard=context_threshold (measured) or guard=context_unmeasured with its live cause, and no compaction side effect. The folded evidence names the guard and the cause. Inventory-only on the live seat is non-PASS. Assistant prose cannot pass the row. The verdict needs no Tempo trace, but review completeness does (#600): tempo-trace-json and tool-trace-correlation stay pending until the collector attributes the request_compaction tool span.
